cohort: 106 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus
finding: Metformin was more effective in controlling mild gestational diabetes mellitus and had comparable maternal and neonatal outcomes to insulin therapy.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was higher in the insulin group (81.5%) compared to the metformin group (57.7%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 3.52 kg in the insulin group and 2.99 kg in the metformin group.
